general.title: MOSuite - plot Volcano Enhanced
general.instructions: Create enhanced volcano plots from differential expression analysis results to visualize fold change and statistical significance

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: Column name for feature IDs (gene names, etc). If not provided, uses first column

parameters.name: Significance column names
parameters.description: Column names of significance values (comma-separated). Example: B-A_adjpval,B-C_adjpval

parameters.name: Significance threshold
parameters.description: Significance cutoff for p-values (FDR, adjusted p-value, etc.)

parameters.name: Fold change column names
parameters.description: Column names of fold change values (comma-separated). Example: B-A_logFC,B-C_logFC

parameters.name: Fold change threshold
parameters.description: Fold change cutoff for significance (log scale)

parameters.name: Sort output by
parameters.description: How to sort output dataset: 'p-value', 'fold-change', or 't-statistic'

parameters.name: Number of features to label
parameters.description: Number of top features/genes to label in the volcano plot

parameters.name: Label selected features only
parameters.description: If TRUE, label only features from custom_gene_list

parameters.name: Custom gene list
parameters.description: Comma-separated feature names or IDs to label

parameters.name: Label significant features only
parameters.description: Label only features that meet the significance and fold change thresholds

parameters.name: Label font size
parameters.description: Size of the labels in the volcano plot

parameters.name: Default label color
parameters.description: Color for automatically selected labels

parameters.name: Custom label color
parameters.description: Color for labels from custom_gene_list

parameters.name: Draw label connector lines
parameters.description: Draw connector lines from labels to their points

parameters.name: Significance axis label
parameters.description: Name for the significance column in the plot

parameters.name: Fold change axis label
parameters.description: Name for the fold change column in the plot

parameters.name: Plot title
parameters.description: Title of the plot

parameters.name: Title font size
parameters.description: Size of the plot title

parameters.name: Use custom labels
parameters.description: If TRUE, uses custom labels for plot axes

parameters.name: Use default X-axis limit
parameters.description: If TRUE, choose X-axis limits automatically

parameters.name: X-axis limit
parameters.description: Positive X-axis limit; used symmetrically as -value to +value when default X-axis limit is disabled

parameters.name: Use default Y-axis limit
parameters.description: If TRUE, choose Y-axis limits automatically

parameters.name: Y-axis limit
parameters.description: Upper Y-axis limit used when default Y-axis limit is disabled

parameters.name: Axis label size
parameters.description: Size of the axis labels

parameters.name: Axis tick label size
parameters.description: Size of axis tick labels

parameters.name: Point size
parameters.description: Size of the points in the plot

parameters.name: Significance threshold line color
parameters.description: Color of the significance threshold line

parameters.name: Non-significant feature color
parameters.description: Color of non-significant features

parameters.name: Fold change threshold color
parameters.description: Color of features meeting only the fold change threshold

parameters.name: Significance-only feature color
parameters.description: Color of features meeting only the significance threshold

parameters.name: Significance and fold change feature color
parameters.description: Color of features meeting both significance and fold change thresholds

parameters.name: Image width (pixels)
parameters.description: Output image width in pixels

parameters.name: Image height (pixels)
parameters.description: Output image height in pixels

parameters.name: DPI
parameters.description: Dots per inch of the output image

parameters.name: Interactive plots
parameters.description: Whether to create interactive plotly plots

parameters.name: Plot filename
parameters.description: Plot output filename
